primary_input: riaz_inputs_v2 approved plus unique previous symbols
scores: 51 baseline patients including 2 unknown-response; mean within-baseline gene z of log2(1+CPM), ddof1, >=48 variable mapped genes; fixed 15 CM x 2 branches
secondary_response: CR/PR vs PD only; omit SD, explicitly different clinical contrast
testing: fixed direction higher score predicts response; exact two-sided MWU unless ties; 9999 label permutations within prior-ipilimumab cohort, centered on stratum-specific null expectation
family: joint BH across all Riaz input versions/response contrasts/CM/branches/test methods and prior 120 Hugo tests; separate ICI family from TCGA immune-fraction hypotheses
limitations: previously used retrospective cohorts, no untreated comparator, small responder count; no response-trained genes/threshold or classifier; not validated treatment-specific prediction
